finding: P0 — a fresh public Sandbox project has no financial owner and no public way to get one
method: external cleanroom — a brand-new identity, public interfaces only

reproduction.1_identity: POST /auth/request-otp → a real six-digit code, delivered by the product → POST /auth/verify → session. No SQL, no session minting.

4_what_the_developer_then_sees.GET /projects/{id}/refund-capability: 200 {allowed:true, configured:true, role:OWNER} — untrue, and fixed at c868fed3

cause: The project has no ACTIVE binding, so no merchant, so every financially-derived surface answers not-found.
the_blocker: The only binding endpoint is POST /internal/v1/projects/{projID}/binding, guarded by the internal service key. It is invisible to the developer, uncallable by them, and has no request mechanism, no pending state and no completion signal. Completion becomes visible only when three 404s silently turn into 200s.
verdict: FAIL — an onboarding step required for the advertised journey that the developer can neither perform nor observe.
note: Preserved as written. The fix does not rewrite this record.
